text: I'll help you log in and request for a loan. Let me start by taking a screenshot to see the current state of the page.
Good! I can see the ParaBank login page. I can see the Customer Login form with Username and Password fields. I'll now log in using the stored credentials. I'll enter the username first.
Good! The username has been entered. Now I'll enter the password.
Perfect! The password has been entered. Now I'll click the "LOG IN" button to complete the login.
Excellent! The login was successful. I can now see the Account Services page with a menu on the left. I can see "Request Loan" option in the menu. I'll click on it to request a loan.
I see the "Apply for a Loan" form with fields for Loan Amount, Down Payment, and From account #. Since the goal doesn't specify these values, I need to ask a human for them.
The fields have been filled in by the human: Loan Amount, Down Payment, and From account #. Now I'll click "APPLY NOW" to submit the loan request.

The loan has been approved. The page shows "Loan Request Processed", Status: Approved, and a new account number. Let me extract the confirmation details - the new account number serves as the confirmation/reference number.
Now I'll log out as the final step.
